_notes: E2 — California daily overtime. One crew day (06:00 time-in, 19:00 time-out) is one job card.
AG CA 2022 is the 2022 agricultural schedule: 1.5x after 8 hours a day, 2x after 12. A 13-hour day splits into
8 regular, 4 at 1.5x and 1 at 2x, carried in three separate columns. The draft catalog said double time after 10;
PR #103 measured 11.5 h as 8 regular + 3.5 at 1.5x + 0 at 2x, which is the 12-hour schedule, so the day was lengthened.
No meal: E2 CREW has no lunch length, and PR #103 measured a meal of 0 on this crew. The tenant's employeeMeal*
preferences did not deduct one. The flow refuses to run if the crew gains a lunch length.
Every derivation keys on net hours, never gross. The thresholds live in the legacy rule editor
(catalog A10) and are proven by consequence — the 8/4/1 split and the 320.00 amount.
